passage:
Students at a technology workshop received small stickers to cover laptop cameras. Some laughed and said they were unnecessary.
The instructor explained that camera privacy is only one small part of digital safety. More important habits include updating software, checking links, using strong passwords, and controlling app permissions.
The sticker became a symbol. It reminded students to ask what their devices could see, hear, and share.
After the workshop, one student checked his phone apps and found several had location access they did not need.
Privacy is not only about hiding secrets. It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.
